set.body: Build thin outer-module adapters: atlas parcel series into existing connectivity estimators with canonical nodes/order/timing; named batch extraction over the same reducer; atlas-specific supported transport plans over existing spatial/transform machinery. Keep scheduling/acquisition outside atlas core and retain plan/attempt/receipt distinctions. Acceptance: realistic workflow examples with exact owner checks, timing/node identity and transform direction, JVM/JS appropriate checks. Spin inference and general soft atlas membership require separate scientific designs and tickets when pursued.
set.title: Atlas: connect parcel fields to connectivity, batch and transport workflows
